lines.text: By the rivers of Babylon the captives sat and wept, and they hung their harps on the willows.
Captors requested a song of Zion, and the psalmist asks how to sing the LORD's song in a foreign land.
The writer asks that his left hand cease to function if he forgets Jerusalem.
The writer asks the LORD to remember Moab, who said on the day Jerusalem fell, "Tear it down."
The writer calls blessed whoever repays Babylon as it has done to them and dashes its infants against rocks.
